out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC PROVIDED PAPER TOWLES AT HAND SINKS AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Multiple food items in the walk-in refrigerator were being stored on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO STORE ALL FOODS 6 INCHES OFF THE GROUND AT ALL TIMES. BY NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION, PLEASE MAKE SURE ALL FOODS IS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for wafer cookies were observed being reused for the storage of cooked food items such as beef, potatoes, noodles, etc.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PLEASE STOP THE RE-USE OF MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: Multiple spatulas and cooking tongs were observed to be in poor condition with chucks missing from the silicone part of the spatulas and tongs and looked to be no longer easily cleanable.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. PLEASE REPLACE ALL BROKEN AND NON-USEABLE UTENSILS BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: The Maxx Cold 1DR UPR had cardboard lining the shelving units and mold was growing n the cardboard.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT CARDBOARD IS NOT ALLOWED TO BE USED TO LINE SHELVING UNITS AND PIC REMOVED AND THREW AWAY CARDBOARD.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the food thawing using an improper method: fish
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. This was addressed using one of the options above.
